body:
### Summary

Running `uvx -vv nox --version` segfaults when running on alpine:3.24 on riscv64 (both qemu & real hardware).
Version 0.12.5 also segfaults (at least under qemu).

Reproducer (running on riscv64):
```
docker run --rm -it alpine:3.24
apk add bash pipx
pipx install uv==0.12.4
pipx ensurepath && source ~/.bashrc
uvx -vv nox --version
```

<details>

<summary>uv output</summary>

```

Segmentation fault (core dumped)
```

</details>

Running the following commands (under qemu this time), I could confirm that the issue only seems to affect the statically linked executable:
```
docker run -it --rm quay.io/pypa/manylinux_2_39_riscv64:latest
cd root
curl -fsSLO https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/a0/96/ca0497ef8912ef48dbbc9982a8b4212260c34d56bfd0d45fe67b31942121/uv-0.12.5-py3-none-manylinux_2_31_riscv64.whl
curl -fsSLO https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/73/95/4c3f060e95f7cbe9177b4ab361f0cbfc4ae22e5a49b22e73eee9f0d0a6ca/uv-0.12.5-py3-none-manylinux_2_31_riscv64.musllinux_1_1_riscv64.whl
pipx uninstall uv
pipx install uv-0.12.5-py3-none-manylinux_2_31_riscv64.musllinux_1_1_riscv64.whl
uvx -vv nox --version  # segfaults
pipx uninstall uv
pipx install uv-0.12.5-py3-none-manylinux_2_31_riscv64.whl
uvx -vv nox --version  # does not segfaults
```
Given `uv-0.12.5-py3-none-manylinux_2_31_riscv64.whl` exists, it might be a good idea to remove the `manylinux_2_31_riscv64` tag from the wheel bundling the statically linked executable, at least for now.

While these reproducers use the PyPI distribution, the same can be observed using `curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh` where it segfaults on musl but not glibc.

xref https://github.com/pypa/manylinux/discussions/1426#discussioncomment-18026891

### Platform

alpine:3.24 riscv64

### Version

uv 0.12.4

### Python version

Python 3.14.7
title: statically linked uv segfaults on riscv64
